title: Private deployment on-ramp: sprint buckets, cohort gating & capacity signal matrix
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Context:
We need a concrete, executable quarterly plan to accelerate enterprise Private/VPC/on-prem adoption. Previous roadmap artifacts have focused on high-level waves; this ticket converts that into sprint-sized buckets, defines numeric gating thresholds for customer cohorts, and codifies a capacity signal matrix so SRE, Dedicated, and Sales know when to open new tranches.

Objectives:
- Produce a sprint-by-sprint rollout plan (6 sprints) that maps features, infra milestones, and GTM milestones to specific weeks.
- Define cohort gating criteria (alpha, pilot, early GA, scale) with measurable thresholds (availability, latency P50/P95, onboarding time, support ticket rate, cost per 1k tokens).
- Create a capacity signal matrix with actionable triggers (scale-up, throttling, canary rollback) tied to telemetry sources (Console dashboards, infra metrics, billing signals).
- Deliver a customer on-ramp checklist and a cross-functional runbook to lower time-to-first-success for enterprise customers.

Scope:
- Covered: Private control plane features (RBAC, audit logs), upgrade/compatibility checks, Dedicated autoscale knobs, onboarding templates, security review path.
- Not covered: long-term pricing model changes and large multi-region federation work (separate initiative).

Acceptance criteria:
- Sprint plan doc with 6 sprint buckets published and attached to this ticket.
- Cohort gating matrix with numeric thresholds approved by PM, Sales, SRE, and Security.
- Capacity signal matrix with 5 signals and automated alert runbooks for each.
- Onboarding checklist with required artifacts (KMS integration steps, network pre-checks, customer test prompts).

Key milestones (high level):
- Sprint 1 (week 1-2): onboarding checklist v1, GA RBAC hardening, audit log schema finalized.
- Sprint 2: Dedicated autoscale policy UI + default policy presets for enterprise.
- Sprint 3: Compatibility verification tool for on-prem packages; upgrade rollback test harness.
- Sprint 4: Integration of capacity signals into Console dashboards; alerting playbooks.
- Sprint 5: Pilot cohort onboarding (2 customers) using the on-ramp checklist; capture metrics.
- Sprint 6: Early GA open for cohort 1; post-pilot retro and OKR metrics collected.

Cohort gating thresholds (proposed):
- Alpha -> Pilot: uptime >= 99.0% over a 7-day window; P95 latency <= 300ms for generation; successful KMS handshake in < 30s; onboarding time < 5 days.
- Pilot -> Early GA: uptime >= 99.5% over 14 days; P95 <= 200ms; < 0.5 support tickets per 1k tokens; cost per 1M tokens within 15% of estimate.
- Early GA -> Scale: uptime >= 99.9% over 30 days; P95 <= 150ms; regression rate < 1% on evaluation prompt suite; successful autoscale events without manual intervention for 7 days.

Capacity signal matrix (sample signals):
- GPU util > 85% sustained for 10m => trigger autoscale evaluation (SRE + infra).
- Queue length > 200 requests for 5m => auto-burst policy enablement and throttle to lower-tier model variants.
- Token spend delta > 40% QoQ for a cohort => finance review and quota gating.
- Failed KMS handshakes > 0.2% => rollback to previous KMS integration and engage Security.
- Error rate (5xx) > 0.5% => open incident playbook and consider canary rollback.

- SRE: Camille Ortiz
- Security: Arjun Desai
- Sales: Kendra Li (Enterprise AE lead)

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Upgrades causing customer data migration regressions. Mitigation: Compatibility verification + canary upgrade and automated rollback procedure.
- Risk: Capacity underprovisioning during scale. Mitigation: conservative burst budgets and simulated load tests before opening cohort.
- Risk: Security review delays. Mitigation: parallelize security checklist and pre-approve standard KMS/HSM patterns.

Open decisions:
- Exact numeric thresholds for cost-related gating (finance input required).
- Whether to include a separate "network readiness" automated test in sprint 1 or 2.
